evals.prompt: Use the complexa-binder-design workflow to prepare the local co-complex /workspace/input/target_prep/complex.pdb. Target chain B; use only partner chain A to define the interface. Follow /workspace/input/CONTRACT.md and write the preparation under /workspace/output/interface. These are synthetic CPU-only fixtures. Work offline; no generation or refolding.
evals.expected_output: Prepared target contains B10 ALA, B20 GLY and B30 SER only, retaining original coordinates/numbering. Hotspots are B10(ALA) and B20(GLY), derived from partner A; C contacts are excluded. All target geometry checks pass. No model execution claim.
assertions: [interface] Computes contacts from the selected B/A interface rather than pooling contacts to C or guessing residues.
[geometry] Retains chain B, original residue identities/numbering/coordinates, excludes partner chains, and saves target_prepared.pdb, hotspots.json and preflight.json.
[preflight] Reports three conditioned residues and two aligned compact hotspots; READY means geometry only.
[coverage] Executes the preparation and reports synthetic offline coverage, without inference or downloads.

evals.expected_output: The supplied B999 is absent, is documented as dropped, and leaves zero conditioned hotspots. Saves target/preflight/hotspot artifacts with a failed >=1_hotspots check; reports NEEDS ATTENTION and does not invent replacements or generate binders.
assertions: [identity] Checks B999 against coordinates and records the missing residue.
[epitope] Does not replace the explicitly supplied patch with contacts to A/C or nearby residues.
[blocked] Saves the failed preflight and empty hotspots and stops dependent generation.
[coverage] Reports synthetic offline preparation only, not a scientific binder NO-GO or an inference result.

evals.prompt: Use the complexa-binder-design gate to re-rank the saved metric export /workspace/input/saved_scores.json under /workspace/output/ranking. Follow /workspace/input/CONTRACT.md. Apply every unchanged gate, rank by independent interface confidence, retain failed/incomplete designs, and write a ranked report with requested versus achieved counts. All metrics are synthetic software fixtures. Work offline; do not run or claim model inference.
evals.expected_output: All eight candidates retained; exactly three pass, ordered tie_higher, tie_lower, boundary. Generator reward, invalid/string values and an explicit prediction failure cannot rescue a design. Request five is unmet: NO-GO, passed=3, delivered=5, evaluated=8, stop_reason=saved_scores_exhausted. The missing apo metric remains null. JSON/CSV/report and provenance summary label synthetic offline coverage.
assertions: [gate] Applies all seven original thresholds, including apo stability and hotspot contact; rejects missing or invalid numbers and explicit failures.
[rank] Ranks passers first, then numeric ipTM and ipSAE_min; generator reward cannot override independent validation.
[audit] Keeps every candidate and failure reason, including the incomplete apo result, in matching JSON and CSV artifacts.
[quota] Reports requested 5 versus passed 3, NO-GO and exhaustion of saved scores without relaxing criteria.
[coverage] Labels results synthetic with no new generation, refolding or verified scientific validation.

evals.prompt: Use the complexa-binder-design workflow to recover the audit for /workspace/input/interrupted_run. Copy the supplied run to /workspace/output/interrupted, preserve its raw evidence, and rebuild the rankings from the authoritative current batch. Follow /workspace/input/CONTRACT.md. Keep missing/failed candidates in the audit and report what remains blocked. These are synthetic saved responses; make no inference calls or retries.
evals.expected_output: Rebuilt JSON/CSV contain exactly stale, timeout and missing, all failed with null unmeasured gate scores. stale is rejected for the wrong batch, timeout retains its failure and missing has a missing-response reason. Orphan and previous derived success cannot enter current rankings. Raw input evidence is unchanged and report discloses zero validated designs and synthetic offline coverage.
assertions: [batch] Uses the current batch candidate list and checks response batch identity; stale and orphan cannot contribute scores.
[recovery] Retains the timeout and missing response as failed rows without retries or invented metrics.
[artifacts] Replaces stale JSON/CSV exports while preserving every original raw response and batch record.
[coverage] Writes a report with the three failures, zero passers and synthetic offline coverage; no live validation claim.
